proposed_measurement.scope: Review-reported upper-continental-slope system span; not a measured reference streamline or dated footprint. The Antarctic Peninsula interrupts circumpolar continuity.

source_scoped_taxonomy_proposal.applies_to: Regional shelf/slope hydrographic regimes in this review, not a whole-current permanent class or global eddy taxonomy

regimes.criterion_summary: Layers with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) do not extend onto the shelf.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) occupies the shelf, which stays relatively cold with convection and dense-water formation.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 reaches the shelf without dense-water formation; shelf water exceeds 0.5 degrees Celsius at some shelf depth.

source_scoped_taxonomy_proposal.density_variable_note: Thresholds refer to the source's neutral-density variable gamma_n in its conventional reported units, not an absolute seawater mass density of 28 kg/m3.
